name: grilling

# Grilling

Clarify the plan naturally until understanding is shared. Walk the decision
tree one branch at a time and give a recommended option with brief reasoning.
When the user explicitly asks for a stress test or to be grilled, challenge
assumptions and edge cases more aggressively; ordinary clarification must stay
proportionate.

- Ask **one** question at a time and wait for the answer.
- Investigate facts available in code, documentation, or tools; do not ask the
  user for them.
- Present real choices to the user. Never decide on their behalf.
- Do not execute the plan before explicit confirmation of shared understanding.
